name: habit-builder-tracker
description: Local-first, offline-capable Habit Builder Tracker with per-profile IndexedDB storage, encryption and portable backups
author: GST Infusion

scripts.android:init: npm run copy:web && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run copy:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cap run android
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.test: node tests/local-storage-smoke.cjs && npm run copy:web && node tests/pwa-shell-smoke.cjs && node tests/electron-local-storage-smoke.cjs
